name: headcountlabs-doctors
description: Find U.S. doctors, nurse practitioners, dentists and other clinicians near a point by plain specialty words, or by name or NPI, from public CMS data (NPPES and Medicare). Also find Medicare-certified hospitals and nursing homes with certified beds and CMS star rating, a clinician's hospital and group affiliations, and specialty counts for an area. Directory facts only, not medical advice; whether a doctor takes new patients is not known. Read-only, no account or API key.
